description: Claude's Voice Mode has received a major beta update that brings support for the Opus and Sonnet AI models alongside new connected services. Users can now access Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Docs, Slack and web search while speaking with the chatbot, without switching back to text. The update also allows seamless transitions between voice and text conversations, retains chat context across both modes and expands Voice Mode's capabilities beyond its earlier dependence on the Haiku model.
title: Anthropic Expands Claude Voice Mode With Opus, Sonnet AI Models

description: HMD Touch AI has reportedly launched in China as a feature phone with a 3.2-inch touchscreen display, Nokia Lumia-inspired design and ByteDance's Doubao AI model. According to a recent report, it supports AI-assisted translation, learning, photography and image generation features, alongside dual 4G, Wi-Fi, hotspot sharing and Alipay QR payments. The handset is said to feature a 2-megapixel rear camera, a 1,950mAh battery, parental controls, an SOS button and is currently available for pre-order at CNY 469 (roughly Rs. 6,700).
title: HMD Touch AI Reportedly Launched in China With Doubao AI, 3.2-Inch Touchscreen

description: Moto Pad 70 will launch in India on August 9. The official teasers reveal that the 5G tablet will have a 12.1-inch display with 2.5K resolution. It will run on a MediaTek Dimensity 6400 SoC. It measures 6.29mm in thickness and weighs 530g. It will be compatible with the Moto folio keyboard. The upcoming tablet has a 10,200mAh battery and supports 68W TurboPower charging. It will go on sale through Flipkart.
title: Moto Pad 70 India Launch Date Announced; Teased to Feature Dimensity 6400 SoC, 10,200mAh Battery

description: RAM prices are expected to fall drastically in 2027, a tipster claims. Two Chinese chip manufacturers, namely ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) and Yangtze Memory Technologies (YMTC), are reportedly stockpiling DRAM sticks. The two companies will reportedly offload their accumulated DRAM chip stock in the market next year. While the prices could fall in 2027, the DRAM and NAND stick shortage is expected to last until the first quarter of 2028.
title: Memory and Storage Chip Prices Tipped to Crash Next Year, But the Shortage Could Last Longer

description: OnePlus N6x will be launched in India with a 7,000mAh battery, the tech firm revealed on Friday. The company claims that the OnePlus N6x will offer up to 2.5 days of battery life. On top of this, the smartphone maker has revealed that its upcoming OnePlus N series phone will provide 20.56 hours of video playback, 133.56 hours of music playback, 25.04 hours of social media scrolling, or 11.26 hours of video recording on a single charge. This comes shortly after the company announced that the OnePlus N6x will be launched in India on July 31 at 12 pm IST.
title: OnePlus N6x Battery Capacity Revealed Week Before Launch in India

description: Two separate attacks on crypto bridges operated by AFX and Verus Protocol resulted in more than $31.6 million in stolen assets within seven hours. Blockchain security firm Blockaid detected both incidents, with investigators pointing to compromised validator keys in the AFX exploit rather than flaws in smart contracts. The attacks underscore the persistent security challenges facing cross-chain bridges, one of the most frequently targeted sectors in decentralised finance.
title: Crypto Hacks Hit AFX and Verus Protocol Within Hours, Draining $31.6 Million

description: Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro has appeared on Geekbench ahead of its expected launch, revealing the Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 chipset, Android 16 and 8GB RAM. The benchmark listing also confirms the motherboard codename and benchmark scores. The handset has previously surfaced on Samsung India's website, BIS and Bluetooth SIG, indicating an imminent debut. Earlier reports suggest the phone could feature a 6.7-inch 120Hz Super AMOLED display, a 6,000mAh battery, 45W charging, triple rear cameras and up to six years of Android OS upgrades.
title: Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro Appears on Geekbench Ahead of Anticipated Launch

description: Microsoft has begun testing an ad-supported option on Xbox, the company announced on Thursday. As part of this initiative, Xbox users will be able to stream select games they own without paying for a cloud gaming subscription. During the test phase, the capability will be limited to Xbox Insiders. Microsoft says that the sessions are currently limited to one hour, although the core gameplay experience is claimed to remain free of ad interruptions.
title: Xbox's Free Ad-Supported Game Streaming Begins Testing With One-Hour Session Limit

description: Vivo could launch the Vivo S2 in India on August 6, according to a new leak, with its first sale tipped to begin on August 11. A promotional poster carrying the tagline "Vivo S2: Flows Into Your Hands Soon" has also surfaced online. The handset is expected to return Vivo's S series to India after the Vivo S1 in 2019. Previous leaks suggest it could feature a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 SoC or a MediaTek Dimensity 7360 chipset, a 7,000mAh battery and a 50-megapixel triple rear camera setup.
title: Vivo S2 Reported to Launch in India on August 6; First Sale Date Also Tipped

description: Bitcoin traded lower as rising oil prices, geopolitical tensions and higher Treasury yields weighed on sentiment. Analysts said resilient ETF inflows continue to support prices, while the upcoming Federal Reserve meeting remains the key catalyst for the crypto market.
title: Bitcoin Slips Below $66,000 as Middle East Tensions Pressure Crypto Market

description: Chrome on Android will offer a new notification user experience starting with Chrome 155. Google is introducing a notification subscription entry point built directly into Chrome's Site Controls UI. This will be available after a site has first prompted the user for notifications. The notification permission request will time out when the non-blocking prompt expires, even if the user did not take any action.
title: Google Chrome Could Make Notification Prompts Less Annoying on Android

description: Samsung System LSI Business is targeting a peak clock speed of up to 4.2GHz for the prime core of the Exynos 2700 mobile platform, according to a tipster. However, the leaker says that the results would likely depend on Samsung Foundry’s SF2P manufacturing process yield, beyond 65 percent to 70 percent. The Samsung Exynos 2700 chipset was recently spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with the model number S5E9975. The SoC was listed with a 10-core architecture, featuring one Cluster 1 core clocked at 2.30GHz, four Cluster 2 cores clocked at 2.40GHz, one Cluster 3 core clocked at 2.78GHz, and four Cluster 4 cores, delivering a peak clock speed of 2.88GHz.
title: Exynos 2700 Leak Suggests Samsung is Planning a Big Performance Upgrade

description: Google on Thursday announced the expansion of Gemini Spark to more users. The personal artificial intelligence (AI) agent, which was first announced at Google I/O earlier this year, will be rolling out to Google AI Pro subscribers in the US. Further, Google AI Ultra subscribers in additional markets will gain access to the feature, along with support for local languages. The Mountain View-based tech giant is also expanding Gemini Live to more of its older smart-home hardware.
title: Google Expands Gemini Spark Access to AI Pro, AI Ultra Subscribers; Gemini Live Now Available on Older Home Devices

description: Virat V1 series has been launched in India. The 5G model has a 6,000mAh battery, while the 4G version of Virat V1 carries a 5,000mAh battery. Both models feature a 6.75-inch panel and a 13-megapixel rear camera unit. They run on a Unisoc chipset. The duo will go on sale through Flipkart and the Lava website starting July 31 at 12pm IST.
title: Lava Virat V1 5G, Virat V1 Launched in India With 6.75-Inch Display, Up to 6,000mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: iQOO has launched the iQOO Z11 Lite 5G in India with a starting effective price of Rs. 17,999. The handset features a 6.74-inch 120Hz HD LCD screen, a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset, up to 6GB of RAM and 256GB of storage. It runs on Android 16-based OriginOS 6 and packs a 6,500mAh battery with 44W FlashCharge support. The smartphone also sports a 50-megapixel rear camera, carries an IP65 rating and will go on sale from July 30.
title: iQOO Z11 Lite Launched in India With 50-Megapixel Camera, 6,500mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: WhatsApp is rolling out a new design for message bubbles on iOS. In the latest update, the Message bubbles are said to be rounder than before, and shared media files appear without the traditional borders. The update reportedly complements the Liquid Glass changes. This feature is available to some beta testers. We can expect the design to reach more iOS users in the coming weeks.
title: WhatsApp Rolls Out New Rounded Message Bubble Design on iOS: Report

description: With the launch of Samsung’s new-generation Galaxy Z foldables in the rear window, the conversation is now shifting towards the next-generation flagship Galaxy S-series. The upcoming lineup, ubiquitously known as the Samsung Galaxy S27 series, could bring a notable change in terms of camera hardware. A recent report suggests that the South Korean tech conglomerate is testing a new Sony sensor for the primary camera on the purported Galaxy S27 and Galaxy S27+.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27, Galaxy S27+ Reportedly in Testing With 50-Megapixel Sony Main Cameras

description: ChatGPT Health is now generally available in the US, OpenAI announced on Thursday. OpenAI says that users do not have to connect other apps to ask health-related questions to ChatGPT. However, users who wish to receive personalised and contextual answers to their health queries will have to “securely” connect their Apple Health app and “supported” medical records from different hospital systems in the US, including One Medical and Function Health. Users can access ChatGPT Health from the sidebar or the More menu. ChatGPT will guide users to connect the health records and metrics with the AI chatbot.
title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Health to Offer Personalised Responses Based on Apple Health and Medical Records

description: iQOO 15 Ultra reportedly appeared in the EEC database with model numbers V2546A and I2603. The V2546A is associated with the Chinese variant of the phone. The listing indicates that the phone will launch in global markets soon. The iQOO 15 Ultra was launched earlier this year in China with a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset and a 7,400mAh battery.
title: iQOO 15 Ultra Global Variant Reportedly Spotted on EEC Certification Site

description: Apple could raise the price of the iPhone 18 Pro Max, according to a leak. The handset is tipped to start at CNY 11,000 (roughly Rs. 1,56,700) in China, around CNY 1,000 (roughly Rs. 14,200) more than its predecessor. The reported increase is linked to Apple's A20 Pro chip, which is expected to use TSMC's 2nm process, and rising memory prices. The leak also claims Apple has secured a large share of TSMC's early 2nm production capacity.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Max Could Be Apple's Most Expensive Non-Folding iPhone Yet, Leak Suggests

description: Oppo A7 Pro Max has been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with the model number PYC110. The listing suggests that the Oppo A7 Pro Max will be powered by an octa-core QTI SM4850 chipset, which is said to be Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 SoC. The purported Oppo A7 Pro Max is listed with six efficiency cores clocked at 2.02GHz, along with two performance cores, delivering a peak clock speed of 2.40GHz. Moreover, the Geekbench listing suggests that the smartphone will feature 11.22GB of RAM, which could be marketed as 12GB.
title: Oppo A7 Pro Max Chipset, Performance Details Appear in Geekbench Listing: Expected Specifications

description: Apple released the second public betas of iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 on Thursday. Building upon the release of the first public beta earlier this month, it provides Apple users with another opportunity to test its upcoming operating systems ahead of their stable release later this year. Among the most notable features on iPhone is the new Siri AI experience, which is smarter and has contextual awareness and multi-step task execution capabilities.
title: Apple Rolls Out iOS 27 Public Beta 2 Update for Eligible iPhone Models: See What’s New

description: Qualcomm has been rumoured to be developing the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 series for quite some time now. However, it seems that the chipmaker isn’t done with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 lineup just yet. A tipster claims that the company is preparing a fourth variant of the flagship mobile platform, and it could be aimed at providing a similar premium performance as the existing variants on more affordable smartphones.
title: Qualcomm Reportedly Developing Fourth Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Variant for More Affordable Flagship Phones

description: Apple’s long-rumoured foldable iPhone is expected to be launched in September alongside the iPhone 18 Pro models. A forecast shared by a market research firm suggests that the purported handset could capture as much as a 25 percent share in global foldable smartphone shipments within months of entering the segment. Samsung, which recently launched the new generation Galaxy Z foldables, is expected to retain the top spot with a 28 percent share.
title: iPhone Ultra to Challenge Samsung, Huawei With 25 Percent Market Share Within Months of Launch: Report

description: Oppo K15 has been launched in China as the latest addition to the company’s mid-range K lineup. The new smartphone is available for purchase in the country via the Oppo China online store in a single 12GB + 256GB RAM and storage configuration. The handset is offered in Gale Grey and Rapid White (translated from Chinese) colour options. An octa core MediaTek Dimensity 7360 Super chipset powers the new Oppo K15. The smartphone also features an 8,000mAh battery with support for 80W wired fast charging. It is equipped with a dual rear camera unit, led by a 50-megapixel main shooter.
title: Oppo K15 Launched With 8,000mAh Battery, Dual 50-Megapixel Rear Cameras: Price, Specifications
